title: SMC Recruitment 2026 – Honorary Coach (Contractual) - Table Tennis, Badminton, Volleyball, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Judo, Karate, Gym Posts
shortInfo: SMC has announced notification for Honorary Coach (Contractual) - Table Tennis, Badminton, Volleyball, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Judo, Karate, Gym posts. Required qualification: NIS or equivalent, Sports Authority of India course, CPEd/DPEd/MPEd, HSC with sports participation. Last date to apply: 24-10-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website: https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in
Complete User Registration by entering E-Mail Address, Mobile Number and Captcha, then click Next.
Verify Mobile Number using OTP received on registered mobile number.
Complete Account setup by entering First Name, Last Name, Create Password and Confirm Password, then click SUBMIT.
Verify your email address by clicking the verification link sent to your registered email.
Login using registered email/mobile number and password.
Fill in User Profile with Personal Details (Name, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Address, Language Known, etc.).
From HOME, click ‘Apply Now’ against the desired post/cadre.
Read the detailed advertisement PDF carefully before applying.
Fill in the Application Form with all required details marked with red asterisk (*): Personal Details, Educational Qualification, Experience Details, Document Details.
Enter the auto-generated system code (Captcha).
Read the Declaration and click Yes/No, then click ‘Submit Application’.
Upload Photograph (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 150 KB, 5cm height x 3.6cm width) and Signature (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 50 KB, 2.5cm height x 7.5cm width, black/blue ink on white paper).
Preview the application form, verify all details, and click Confirm.
Download and print the confirmed application form for future reference.
Note: Once confirmed, no changes can be made to the application.

fees.category: Reserved Category (All category females, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, Divyang/PwD, Ex-Servicemen)

howToApply: Visit the official website: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
Click on ‘Online Application’ and then click ‘Apply’, then select GSSSB.
Click on the advertisement for Staff Nurse, Class III (Advertisement No. 458/202627) and click ‘Apply Now’.
Complete OTR (One Time Registration) if not already done. Only OTR-registered candidates can fill the application form.
Enter Registration Number and Date of Birth, then click ‘Apply with OTR’ to open the Application Format.
Fill in ‘Personal Details’ (fields marked with red asterisk * are mandatory).
Fill in ‘Educational Details’.
Accept the ‘Assurance’ (terms and conditions) by selecting ‘Yes’ and click ‘Save’. An Application Number will be generated – save it.

Upload Photograph (5 cm height x 3.6 cm width) and Signature (2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width) in JPG format (max 15 KB each). Photo must have white background with date of photograph (not older than 1 year from last date of application).

Go to ‘Confirm Application’, enter Application Number and Date of Birth, verify all details, make edits if needed, then click ‘Confirm Application’ to get a Confirmation Number. No changes can be made after confirmation.
Pay the examination fee online (Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets) by 15/10/2026 (23:59 hrs). Print/save the fee receipt.
Print the application form and keep it safe until the entire recruitment process is complete.

howToApply: Download the application form from the prescribed format given at Annexure-I in the official notification.
Fill the application form in English or Hindi as per the prescribed format.
Affix a self-attested colour passport size photograph on the application form.

Attach self-attested photocopies of the following documents: Aadhaar card, Matriculation/equivalent mark sheet and certificate, UG/PG/Diploma mark sheet and certificate, Latest Category Certificate (ST/EWS) if applicable, Experience Certificate, NOC from employer (if applicable), and two latest passport size colour photographs.
Enclose a separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp pasted on it, addressed to yourself.
Super-scribe the envelope in BOLD letters: ‘APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF FOREMAN OF STORES’ along with the category applied for.

Send the duly filled application with all attachments by ordinary post only to: The Director General, {For PD (Rectt)}, Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment, C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector-62, Noida, U.P. – 201309.
The application must reach by 03 Nov 2026. Applications sent by hand or courier will not be accepted.
